key_insight: AI Theorist autonomously inferred a new excitonic model for α-RuCl3, explaining optical and photocurrent data with distinct excitonic states and selection rules.
engineering_relevance: The work shows how agentic AI plus first-principles calculations can accelerate model-building from experimental data in quantum materials discovery.
method: Generate physical hypotheses from experimental optical observations
Refine candidates using first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations
Compare predicted excitonic structure against evidence from optical and photocurrent measurements
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a new interpretation of previously unpublished experimental observations in α-RuCl3, supported by first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality experimental inputs and computationally intensive theory workflows, so validation across additional measurements and materials is still needed.
paper_title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $α$-RuCl$_3$
